name: Waranyu Bancherdvanich
summary: Master of Information Systems and Technology student at Curtin University (Data Analytics and Visualisation, CWA 82.18), with a bachelor’s degree in statistics and finance. I build Power BI dashboards on data I have audited and modelled myself, and I forecast in R so the method can be checked. Most recently I was Finance Lead in a 9-person Curtin Consulting Group team working with Hockey WA. Most projects in my portfolio at waranyu-cv.vercel.app have a live demo you can try. Seeking a data analyst internship in Perth, and graduate roles from July 2027.

sections.title: Skills
skills: SQL, Python, Excel, Power BI, Power Query, DAX, Tableau, R, Oracle SQL, data cleaning and quality auditing.
ERD design, dimensional modelling, star and galaxy schemas, normalisation, data dictionaries.
Linear regression, time-series analysis and forecasting in R; break-even, payback, scenario and sensitivity models in Excel; CapEx/OpEx cost estimation.
Requirements gathering and analysis, stakeholder communication and presentations, technical documentation, dashboards and reports.

entries.title: FreshMart Sales Performance Dashboard
entries.org: Power BI, Power Query, Data Cleaning, DAX, Kimball Star Schema
bullets: Audited data quality and cleaned 5 raw operational files in Power Query, remapping 93 orphaned sales rows instead of dropping them, keeping revenue totals accurate and the data gap visible.
Modelled 17,697 transaction lines across 12 stores into a star schema with DAX KPIs for revenue, gross margin and year-on-year growth, showing which regions and categories drive profit.

entries.title: Renewable Electricity Transition Dashboard
entries.org: Power BI, Power Query, DAX, R, Linear Regression, Policy Analysis
bullets: Reconciled data from national energy agencies into a Power BI galaxy schema, showing Australia’s renewable share rising from 9% in 2005 to 35% in 2024, benchmarked against Germany, New Zealand and China.
Linked the trend to policy: share stalled while the Renewable Energy Target was under review, then grew nearly 5 times faster after the 2015 target reset.
Forecast with R linear regression that Australia reaches only 37.8% renewable share by 2030 against the 82% target, showing the target is unlikely on the current trend.

entries.title: Building and Benchmarking a Domain-Specialist AI Model (LocoLLM)
entries.org: Quality and Documentation Manager – Client: LocoLabo, Curtin Business School
bullets: Evaluated the base AI model across 15 business areas and pinpointed Australian privacy law as a weak spot, giving the client clear evidence to approve the project focus.
Learnt enough Australian privacy law to help train a LoRA privacy-law adapter, raising accuracy on a sealed 170-question test from 15% (original untrained model) to 81% (final run).
Documented controlled experiments (one setting changed per run, repeated with a new random seed) in a 6-step handover recipe and client presentation, so the next team can reproduce the method.

entries.title: Football Club Database Design and SQL Implementation
entries.org: Group project (3) – Oracle SQL, ERD, Normalisation
bullets: Translated 18 business requirements into an ERD and a normalised 16-table Oracle schema with a data dictionary, loaded with a full sample season of 56 games.
Wrote 9 analytical SQL queries using joins, subqueries and HAVING to answer organiser questions such as the season ladder, using a LEFT JOIN so goalless games keep averages accurate.

entries.title: IT Infrastructure and Capital Plan for a Government Department
entries.org: Pair project, designed jointly – Excel, Visio
bullets: Costed every item from cited supplier prices in Excel, splitting CapEx and OpEx and keeping Year 1 to about a third of the A$2.1M budget, with the rest reserved for failures and upgrades.
Compared 5 WAN options on cost, latency and reliability, choosing Starlink over Sky Muster for 4 remote sites because of latency (~30 ms vs ~665 ms) for VoIP calls.
